blurb: Skatium is a public ice rink facility with an NHL-sized ice surface hosting hockey tournaments, youth and adult leagues, figure skating showcases, summer skating camps, and instructional clinics for figure skating and hockey. It offers freestyle skating sessions for advanced skaters and public skating sessions for all skill levels. The facility also includes a pro shop for equipment and skate sharpening services.
